column1: # Map experience, one line per area of each map, modelled by map_exp.py (kept out of the repo) on 2026-10-28 from <Diablo II>\
# ProjectD2's tables and layouts (nothing measured in game; see the tool). index: a full clear of the plain map
# (all areas, no level penalty), 100 = the average of the 29 T1-T3 maps. level: monster level (MonLvl3Ex). Per
# area: MonDen(H), MonUMin/MonUMax(H) (elite packs), rolls = expected spawn rolls, reach = their share in the
# player's area, exp per normal roll and per elite pack roll (area level, before any penalty), champ = the
# champions' share of the pack exp (+2 levels; uniques and minions +3), monsters placed in the layout (packs
# and exp, map bosses; not Horazon's Memory's lightning spires, which players walk past), the plain area's
# monsters and exp, its walkable size, rarity = the total weight of its monster list, guests = the guest
# monster stats the map can carry (docs/pd2-map-guests.tsv; a guest joins every area's list with weight 1).
# tools/gen_map_exp.py builds the map formulas from these numbers.
